component: live start sequence (HOLD_STEPS), --hold-on-refusal, compose live service
rule: D-08 failure classes; D-03 hold instead of crash-loop; D106 restart policy; D042 condition 1; continuation of G-2100
summary: A restart on an account that holds a filled, unprotected entry is refused when a HOLD step fails (one unreadable database revision read, gate state file): nothing is started, no stop is placed, and with --hold-on-refusal the process then waits for ever without retrying. The same hold follows any runtime failure of the run. So a restart policy does not bound the outage window of G-2100 in these cases.
expected: A process that starts on an account with an own position and no stop tries to protect it or retries the start; a transient dependency failure does not park it for ever.
actual: ALEMBIC (and CONFIG, GATE, SAFE_MODE, ENABLEMENT) failures return before RECOVERY, STREAM and SCHEDULER; runtime.py turns admitted=False into a held, non-operational process. Probe: admitted False, held ALEMBIC ALEMBIC_UNREADABLE, scheduler and stream not started, position 0.006 with zero stops.
impact: Mainnet example: equity 1000, 440 USDT position filled during a host reboot, database not yet reachable when the live container starts: no stop until the owner restarts by hand; loss bounded by about 88 USDT isolated margin (about 17R) instead of 5 USDT. Now: Demo, attended, restart policy off.
evidence: startup.py:182-184 HOLD_STEPS; startup.py:920-937 one read, StartupRefused(ALEMBIC_UNREADABLE), return; runtime.py:565-570 and 644 (refuse -> hold); runtime.py:593-594 scheduler ended -> same refusal; docker-compose.yml:207-209, 232-235. Probe tmp/failure_scenarios/p5_restart_hold.py (p5.out); contrast p1_crash_resting.py (restart with a readable database protects in the first tick). The host-reboot race itself is PROBABLE, not observed.
why_tests_miss: Restart tests and twins stub alembic_revisions with a matching head (tests/support/live_smoke_env.py:148); hold tests assert that nothing is started.
recommendation: Owner decision: retry the read-only hold steps with a bounded backoff before holding, or exit non-zero under a delayed restart policy for dependency failures; plus an exchange-side bound for resting entries (G-2100).
known_prior: Partly: G-2100, KNOWN:20-DEFERRED blocker row, KNOWN:24-DEFERRED R-22 cover the outage; the refused restart and the no-retry hold were not found recorded.

category: emergency close / stuck state / operator recovery
component: MarketEmergencyCloser.close_position/_poll/restore_pending; ProtectionCoordinator close flow; SAFE_MODE exit readiness
rule: D080 item 1; 25-OWNER-DECISIONS.md:341 (manual close is the action that works in CLOSE_FAILED); RUNBOOK 21.1a row 5; extends G-0301
summary: While an emergency close attempt is held PENDING_UNKNOWN the closer returns before it reads the position, so after the owner flattens the account by hand the plan stays CLOSE_FAILED for ever (31 h and a restart in the probe): reservation stays RESERVED, entries stay blocked, /safemode_exit refuses BLOCKING_PROTECTION_STATE, and no operator command ends it. The planned /close retry (25-32) re-runs the same held step.
expected: Once the exchange shows no position (two zero reads, entry terminal) the plan ends FLAT, the reservation is released and SAFE_MODE can be left by the operator.
actual: close_position polls the pending attempt first and returns _hold for every found=False answer (an order that never reached the exchange is never found); the position is never read. A restart restores the hold as ATTEMPT_HISTORY_NOT_TERMINAL.
impact: Money is safe (entries blocked). The first such incident ends trading until rows of the operational database are edited by hand; on Demo it would stop a soak. Now: LOW.
evidence: emergency_close.py:512-516 (hold before _read_position at 521), 815-819 (found False -> mark_unknown, PENDING), 472-480 (restore_pending). Probes tmp/failure_scenarios/p3b_after_manual.py and p3_close_unknown.py: plan CLOSE_FAILED with pos [] at +1 h, +6 h, +24 h and after restart; reservations ['RESERVED']; /safemode_exit -> 'Exit refused: COMPARE_NOT_CLEAN, BLOCKING_PROTECTION_STATE'; /status 'protections: 1 open of 1 tracked'.
why_tests_miss: S18 and the closer tests fail the close with a definitive rejection (-2022) where the retry flattens; unknown-outcome tests stop at 'nothing is re-sent'; none flattens the account from outside while an attempt is held.
recommendation: When the pending attempt is UNKNOWN still read the position; two zero reads with the entry terminal end the plan FLAT (nothing is sent, D080 untouched). Add a runbook step for CLOSE_FAILED.
known_prior: G-0301 and KNOWN:25-11-F1 cover the hold while the position is open; the state after a manual flatten was not found recorded.
